dash.p0.01.text: In this video, we'll build an interactive dashboard from a file of U.S. flight data, using Claude Code in a GitHub codespace. We won't write any code ourselves.
dash.p0.01.spoken: In this video, we'll build an interactive dashboard from a file of U.S. flight data, using Claude Code in a GitHub code space. We won't write any code ourselves.

dash.p0.02.text: Claude Code can discover the data, propose options, and build the whole solution. That's powerful, but it's also easy to get a result you didn't want if you don't know how to direct it.
dash.p0.02.spoken: Claude Code can discover the data, propose options, and build the whole solution. That's powerful, but it's also easy to get a result you didn't want if you don't know how to direct it.

dash.p0.03.text: This exercise uses a direction prompt. A direction prompt describes the goal, the audience, and the quality you expect, and leaves the technical decisions to the AI. It's how a manager gives direction to an analyst.
dash.p0.03.spoken: This exercise uses a direction prompt. A direction prompt describes the goal, the audience, and the quality you expect, and leaves the technical decisions to the AI. It's how a manager gives direction to an analyst.

dash.p0.04.text: A construction prompt is the opposite. It spells out exactly what to build, such as a bar chart of flights by region, using matplotlib. Use a construction prompt when you know exactly what you want. Use a direction prompt when you know the goal, but not the path.
dash.p0.04.spoken: A construction prompt is the opposite. It spells out exactly what to build, such as a bar chart of flights by region, using mat plot lib... Use a construction prompt when you know exactly what you want. Use a direction prompt when you know the goal, but not the path.
